description: This file contains functions and constants for managing authentication configurations and credentials for AI model providers, including resolving API keys, handling environment variables, and applying authorization headers.

methods.name: resolveProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the provider configuration from the given config object and provider name.

methods.name: getCustomProviderApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the custom API key for a specified provider from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveUsableCustomProviderApiKey
methods.description: Resolves a usable custom API key, considering environment variables and markers.

methods.name: hasUsableCustomProviderApiKey
methods.description: Checks if a usable custom API key exists for a provider.

methods.name: shouldPreferExplicitConfigApiKeyAuth
methods.description: Determines if explicit config API key authentication should be preferred for a provider.

methods.name: resolveProviderAuthOverride
methods.description: Resolves the authentication mode override for a provider.

methods.name: isLocalBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local base URL.

methods.name: hasExplicitProviderApiKeyConfig
methods.description: Checks if the provider configuration explicitly has an API key.

methods.name: isCustomLocalProviderConfig
methods.description: Checks if a provider configuration is a custom local provider.

methods.name: isManagedSecretRefApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Checks if an API key marker indicates a managed secret reference.

methods.name: resolveProviderSyntheticRuntimeAuth
methods.description: Resolves synthetic runtime authentication for a provider, considering config and runtime config.

methods.name: resolveSyntheticLocalProviderAuth
methods.description: Synthesizes local provider auth if applicable, especially for local servers.

methods.name: resolveEnvSourceLabel
methods.description: Generates a label for environment variable sources, indicating if shell environment was applied.

methods.name: resolveAwsSdkAuthInfo
methods.description: Resolves AWS SDK authentication info based on environment variables.

methods.name: shouldDeferSyntheticProfileAuth
methods.description: Determines if synthetic profile auth should be deferred based on plugin logic.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyForProvider
methods.description: Resolves the API key for a provider, considering profiles, environment, and local configs.

methods.name: resolveModelAuthMode
methods.description: Determines the authentication mode for a provider.

methods.name: hasAvailableAuthForProvider
methods.description: Checks if there is available authentication for a provider.

methods.name: getApiKeyForModel
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a specific model, resolving provider credentials.

methods.name: applyLocalNoAuthHeaderOverride
methods.description: Overrides the authorization header for local models that do not require auth.

methods.name: applyAuthHeaderOverride
methods.description: Injects an Authorization header into the model if configured to do so.
